title: Zainab giri hai
body:
zainab giri hai naaqe se abbas ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon ka girte waqt sahara liye bina
zainab giri hai naaqe se abbas ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu bandhe huwe hai dilafgaar kya kare
koi nahi hai bekas o lachaar kya kare
na mehramon ka majma hai aur sar bhi hai khula
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
naaqe ki wo buland wo unchayi al amaan
taqdeer kis maqam pe le aayi al amaan
beti ali o fatema zehra ki mehlaqa
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai behan mein thi wo mohabat na poochiye
bandhwa diye hai haath jo bhai ke kat gaye
sar par laga jo gurz to zainab hai be rida
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye haye sitam wo ho gaya ek nazneen par
naaqe se moo ke bal giri aakar zameen par
tharra raha tha arsh larazti thi karbala
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun hai jo aan ke dharas bandhayega
jalti hui zameen se aa kar uthayega
abbas hai na qasim o akbar sa mehlaqa
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jakda hua hai bedi mein ye abid e hazeen
baba ki laash dekh ke mar jaye na kahin
dekha junhi mareez ka chehra bujha hua
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bibi sayyeda zara tashreef laaiye
beti ko apni godh mein aa kar uthaiye
jalti hui zameen pe bicha dijiye rida
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
<<DIVIDER>>
lafzon mein ainee kaise musibat likhe koi
aamir wo rassiyon se kalayi bandhi hui
girte hue zaban pe ali ya ali hi tha
zainab giri hai naaqe se...
author: Ainee Rizvi
